source_snapshot.procedure: Spray water near the CDU connector, observe a warning, wipe the area dry and observe warning clearance.
source_snapshot.criteria: Leak sensor records warning/error; system performs the correct behavior, example shutdown within one minute; sensor recovers when the connector is dry.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek correctly identifies physical leak injection as unavailable over SSH but stops at MANUAL/NO and does not classify the automatable sensor, event, shutdown-timing and recovery evidence.

original_test_intent.purpose: Validate that the connector-specific liquid-leak sensor detects an approved simulated leak near the CDU connector, triggers the platform-defined warning and protective behavior, and returns to the normal state after authorized dry restoration.
original_test_intent.target: One identified CDU connector leak-detection zone, its sensor/channel, BMC/SEL/OS alarm path and the SUT power/cooling response defined by the platform specification.
original_test_intent.scope: One human-applied, vendor-approved, contained leak simulation followed by one dry-state restoration. Automation may collect and correlate sensor, event, reachability, power-state and timing evidence but may not create, spread, wipe or declare a liquid condition safe.
original_test_intent.operation: Preserve dry baseline; arm read-only sensor/event/power monitoring; have a qualified operator apply the exact approved medium/quantity/location; capture alarm and platform-defined response timing; after evidence and safety authorization, have the operator remove the medium and restore dry state; verify automated sensor/event recovery and final cooling/electrical health.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The workbook estimates 20 attended and 20 machine minutes and describes one wet/dry cycle.
original_test_intent.expected_result: The correct sensor and event path assert for the approved simulation, the platform performs its specified protective action within its specified time, and the sensor deasserts/returns normal only after the connector zone is verified dry. `Shutdown in 1 min` is an example, not a universal acceptance value without the platform policy.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT/CDU/connector/sensor identity; owner-approved medium/method/quantity/location and safety controls; dry baseline; synchronized physical action, sensor, BMC/SEL/OS, power/reachability and response-time evidence; operator photos; dry confirmation; deassert/recovery event; restored cooling/electrical and final platform health.
ambiguities: The source says spray water but does not define an electrically safe, materials-compatible medium, amount, distance or containment method.
The phrase `correct behavior ex: shutdown in 1 min` does not establish whether shutdown is mandatory or merely an example, nor define the timer start/end.
The exact connector sensor, alarm route, deassert behavior and latching/reset policy are missing.
Wiping dry is not a sufficient electrical-safety clearance criterion without the vendor SOP.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 supplies strong and necessary physical, liquid/electrical, evidence and recovery controls. Its MANUAL ONLY classification conflicts with its own contract: the agent is explicitly assigned baseline collection, armed sensor/BMC/OS/SEL monitoring, shutdown timing, event correlation and dry-state recovery verification. Only the stimulus and physical safety judgments are manual.

applicable_history.decision: Historical NO identifies the essential physical injection boundary. It does not establish that the independent read-only monitoring and timing portions lack automation capability.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Reclassify from MANUAL ONLY to the hybrid class because meaningful, outcome-critical evidence collection is automatable while the leak stimulus, drying and physical safety remain operator-only. No current execution is authorized and all V2 safety gates remain.

available_now: The wet/assert/dry/recover sequence and one-cycle scope are identifiable.
Read-only baseline sensor, event, power and reachability data can be collected before a simulation.
Once the operator acts, automated monitoring can provide objective alarm and one-minute/policy timing evidence.
missing_inputs: Exact connector/sensor mapping, alarm/deassert policy, mandatory protective action, response timer definition and recovery acceptance.
Vendor-approved safe simulator/medium, quantity/location, containment, PPE, ESD/electrical controls, dry-verification method and emergency isolation SOP.
Qualified operator, isolated SUT, explicit outage/liquid-fault approval, synchronized evidence package and recovery access.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The platform/liquid-cooling vendor defines the method, sensor and policy; the lab safety owner supplies the qualified operator and controls; the system owner approves outage and recovery; automation owner supplies read-only monitors.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Inventory the connector/sensor, record dry-state readings and existing events, verify power/reachability, collect policy artifacts and test the evidence clock synchronization without adding liquid or clearing logs.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not spray water/coolant, manipulate the connector, wipe or declare dry, isolate power/cooling, reboot, clear logs, assume one-minute shutdown, reset a latched sensor, or remotely instruct an unqualified person to perform the simulation.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Approve a connector-specific SOP and policy that defines medium, amount, placement, timer, expected protective state, emergency isolation, objective dry clearance, sensor deassert/latch behavior and recovery; verify operator, monitoring and approvals immediately before execution.

revision_candidate.test_name: CDU Connector Leak Sensor Wet/Dry Detection and Recovery
revision_candidate.purpose: Validate one identified CDU connector leak sensor's assertion, platform-protective response and dry-state recovery during one authorized, contained simulation.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Only the exact CDU/connector, coolant/electrical design, leak sensor and firmware covered by the vendor/platform safety procedure in an isolated lab SUT.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One connector leak zone, one approved wet/assert/dry/recover cycle and its sensor, event and platform-response chain.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Connector/sensor map; approved simulation medium/device, quantity and placement; alarm/deassert and shutdown policy with timer definition; qualified operator; containment/PPE/ESD/electrical controls; emergency isolation; objective dry check; approvals; synchronized BMC/SEL/OS/power monitor; recovery procedure.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve dry baseline and arm read-only sensor, event, reachability and power-state monitors. A qualified operator applies only the approved contained stimulus at the identified connector. Automation timestamps assertion, alarm/event and platform response against the approved policy. After evidence capture and safety authorization, the operator removes the stimulus and completes the objective dry-restoration procedure; automation records deassert/recovery and final health. The agent never handles liquid or physical hardware.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Exact target and normal dry baseline verified; logs preserved; platform policy and timer approved; no production exposure; safe simulator/containment/clearance method qualified; operator, emergency isolation and recovery present; explicit fault/outage approval recorded.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Target and SOP identity; dry baseline; synchronized application timestamp and operator photos; sensor assertion, raw BMC/SEL/OS events, power/reachability timeline and measured protective-response interval; removal/dry clearance; sensor deassert or documented latch handling; final cooling/electrical/platform health and no unresolved fluid migration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The exact vendor connector/leak-sensor and platform protective-action specification plus the approved liquid/electrical lab SOP; the source's one-minute value is not universal until confirmed there.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Physical liquid activity is human-only. Never use unapproved water/coolant, exceed the qualified amount/location, work without containment/PPE/isolation, clear logs, touch energized unsafe hardware, continue after migration/electrical/thermal anomaly, or infer dry safety from visual wiping alone.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Platform, lab-safety and system owners approve the target, medium/method, protective action, timing, outage, emergency and recovery; a qualified operator confirms immediately before wetting and drying actions.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The operator performs and documents all liquid application/removal, physical observation, isolation and dry/electrical clearance. The agent only monitors and correlates read-only data and cannot certify the connector safe.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop the stimulus, use approved containment/isolation, preserve evidence, complete vendor dry/restoration and inspection, verify sensor normal/latch handling and cooling/electrical integrity, and recover power only after owner clearance. Quarantine on leakage, migration, failed protection or non-recovery; never auto-retry.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved method/policy/timer; wrong connector/sensor; abnormal baseline; missing operator/approval/containment/isolation/recovery; actual uncontrolled leak; fluid migration; electrical or thermal hazard; wrong/no alarm; missed protective response; lost monitoring; unexpected shutdown; sensor non-recovery; or failed dry/electrical inspection.

identified_defects: V2 labels the whole test MANUAL ONLY while assigning substantial objective monitoring and validation to automation.
Source water-spray and wipe instructions lack safe method and objective dry clearance.
The one-minute shutdown criterion is presented as an example and cannot be treated as a universal hard value.
Source log clearing would erase evidence needed for event correlation.
reason_for_change: Correct the capability classification to reflect a genuine hybrid workflow without delegating any liquid, physical or safety-critical action to the agent or weakening V2's protective gates.

new_technical_evidence.title: Original testcase row
new_technical_evidence.applicability: This exact CDU connector leak case
new_technical_evidence.supports: The row requires physical wet/dry actions but also observable warning/error, timed system behavior and sensor recovery, establishing both manual and automatable phases.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The platform policy, safe simulator and objective dry criteria remain owner/vendor inputs.

new_technical_evidence.title: Review Workflow Logic V3
new_technical_evidence.supports: Human setup or action plus automatable evidence must be represented as a hybrid capability when technically feasible, while missing approval/spec/package remains in readiness and safety gates.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Actual execution remains prohibited until the listed readiness inputs are closed.

removed_ambiguities: Separates physical wet/dry actions from automated sensor/event/timing verification.
Treats one-minute shutdown as pending platform policy rather than a universal value.
Requires objective dry clearance and defined latch/deassert behavior.
resolved_blockers: The absence of remote liquid manipulation no longer erases the automatable monitoring and evidence portion; the case is represented as hybrid rather than all-manual.
remaining_blockers: Vendor-approved medium/method, sensor/policy/timer, objective dry criteria, operator/safety controls and approvals are absent; physical execution is not ready.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 aligns classification with the actual division of labor documented by V2, enabling objective automated evidence without moving a single physical or safety judgment away from the qualified operator.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The contract-only validator recovered the one-zone/one-cycle purpose, missing SOP/policy/timer/safety inputs, safe dry baseline reads, operator-only liquid and clearance actions, authorization, evidence, stops and completion. It rejected universal one-minute timing, agent dry certification, sensor-deassert-only safety, alarm-only completion, log clearing and automatic retry. No document, platform-handoff or model-planning failure was identified.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Functionality row 1533 has one wet/dry connector cycle with warning, timed protective behavior and sensor recovery.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2's narrative is hybrid but its MANUAL ONLY label hides automatable monitoring and correlation.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Permit read-only baselining/monitoring only; reserve all liquid, physical, dry-clearance and safety actions to a qualified operator under an approved SOP.
